case.summary: Alert HHF-005 opened because customer C00348 disputed transaction 3660250 ($4.05, product C, online, 2017-01-28 20:45) on card C00348-K1. Assessed as an undocumented coordinated pattern with fraud probability 0.95. Main findings: The slow micro-charge shape appears on 11 other customers' cards with no micro-charge habit in the 30 days to 2017-01-28 against 1.0 per 30 days over the previous 3 windows: charges too small to trip any threshold, repeated across customers; 6 online charges of $2.10 to $5.08 within 21.2 days on card C00348-K1, each under $10, with no larger purchase after them and only 0 such charge in the 90 days before: slow card probing rather than the one-hour R5 test. The episode covers 6 transaction(s) totalling $23.17, and 11 other card(s) are linked by the same slow micro-charge shape (5 or more online charges under $6 in 30 days on a card with no micro-charge habit). sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C00348, card C00348-K1, issued as a mastercard debit. Between 2017-01-07 and 2017-01-28, 6 transaction(s) totalling $23.17 were identified as part of one fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3660245. The activity took place online, product code(s) C, billing region(s) 264, 325. The transactions were small online charges of a few dollars spread over several weeks, never followed by a larger purchase, the same shape appearing on other customers' cards in the same weeks. The activity is assessed as an undocumented coordinated pattern: The slow micro-charge shape appears on 11 other customers' cards with no micro-charge habit in the 30 days to 2017-01-28 against 1.0 per 30 days over the previous 3 windows: charges too small to trip any threshold, repeated across customers; 6 online charges of $2.10 to $5.08 within 21.2 days on card C00348-K1, each under $10, with no larger purchase after them and only 0 such charge in the 90 days before: slow card probing rather than the one-hour R5 test. The shared element (the same slow micro-charge shape (5 or more online charges under $6 in 30 days on a card with no micro-charge habit)) links this activity to 11 other card(s), including C00129-K1, C01326-K2, C01525-K2, C02851-K2, which indicates a common actor across cardholders. Earlier confirmed cases CC-2971, CC-3035, CC-2985 show the same pattern. The cardholder reported the disputed transaction to the bank and denied making it. The bank has recommended BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS and opened an internal case; the report is filed under R9, §3a.
